updates.body:
On November 4, 2026, between 15:49 UTC and 16:48 UTC, and again between 17:20 UTC and 17:55 UTC, GitHub Actions, Pages, Webhooks, Code Scanning, and Copilot coding agent experienced delays. During this time, Actions workflow runs and job status updates were delayed by up to 25 minutes. Pages deployments dropped to about 4% of normal volume, webhook deliveries dropped to about 58% of normal volume, and Code Scanning analyses and Copilot coding agent sessions were delayed. Delayed events were processed after mitigation.

This incident was caused by a configuration change to an internal event-routing service that unexpectedly paused delivery of several event streams. The change depended on feature flags that were not set up as intended, which the service did not handle gracefully. We mitigated the first period by rolling back the configuration change at 16:14 UTC. The code change
The degradation has been mitigated. We are monitoring to ensure stability.
We are investigating reports of degraded performance for Actions and Pages

result.answer:
**Không thể khẳng định incident Phoenix là nguyên nhân gây lỗi Spectrum tại Việt Nam.**

### Dữ liệu từ tool (captured 2026-11-09T03:50:47Z):
- **Incident hiện tại**: `c60k3g4vsoc1` – “Spectrum Availability Issue in Phoenix”, status **monitoring** (cập nhật cuối 2026-11-07T02:51:59Z).  
  Nguồn: https://www.cloudflarestatus.com/incidents/c60k3g4vsoc1  
  - Phạm vi theo update chính thức: “issues with Spectrum in Phoenix”.  
  - Component ảnh hưởng: Spectrum (không ghi nhận vị trí khác).  
  - Không có cập nhật nào đề cập Việt Nam hay khu vực châu Á.

- **Trạng thái component**: Spectrum → **degraded_performance** (overall partial outage). Phoenix (PHX) component → **operational**.

- **Giới hạn bằng chứng**: Tool chỉ quét 50 incident gần nhất theo chuỗi “Phoenix”/“Spectrum”. Không tìm thấy không đồng nghĩa không có incident khác. Incident này được tạo và cập nhật chỉ trong ngày 07/11, chưa có thông tin lan rộng.

Vì vậy, **không đủ cơ sở** để kết luận Phoenix gây lỗi tại Việt Nam (phạm vi địa lý và component bị giới hạn).

### Bước kiểm tra tiếp theo (khuyến nghị):
1. Gọi `get_status` Cloudflare **không chỉ định component** để xem toàn bộ incident đang active.
2. Kiểm tra incident khác bằng cách gọi `get_incident_details` với các ID mới (nếu có).
3. Kiểm tra log/error của Spectrum tại VN (edge location, error code, thời gian chính xác) để so sánh với thời gian incident Phoenix.
4. Nếu cần, kiểm tra thêm component “Spectrum” + từ khóa khác (ví dụ “Asia”, “Vietnam”) qua tool.

updates.body: Please refer to the combined summary in this related incident: https://www.githubstatus.com/incidents/xr3myzj7ms51
The degradation affecting Actions has been mitigated. We are monitoring to ensure stability.
We are investigating reports of degraded availability for Actions

On November 4, 2026, between 15:49 UTC and 16:48 UTC, and again between 17:20 UTC and 17:55 UTC, GitHub Actions, Pages, Webhooks, Code Scanning, and Copilot coding agent experienced delays. During this time, Actions workflow runs and job status updates were delayed by up to 25 minutes. Pages deployments dropped to about 4% of normal volume, webhook deliveries dropped to about 58% of normal volume, and Code Scanning analyses and Copilot coding agent sessions were delayed. Delayed events were processed after mitigation.

This incident was caused by a configuration change to an internal event-routing service that unexpectedly paused delivery of several event streams. The change depended on feature flags that were not set up as intended, which the service did not handle gracefully. We mitigated the first period by rolling back the configuration change at 16:14 UTC. The code change
